behaviors.title: SSH password guessing / spraying against exposed services
behaviors.description: Sustained authentication failures from one source against one or many accounts over SSH. Behavioral, not atomic: the source address rotates cheaply, the behavior (guess, fail, iterate) does not.
markers: Repeated failed password events from a single source address
Failure bursts across many usernames (spray) or one username (targeted)
Failure-then-success from the same source shortly afterwards
false_positives: An administrator mistyping a password several times
A misconfigured automation retrying with stale credentials

behaviors.title: Interactive evidence destruction after hands-on-keyboard activity
behaviors.description: Clearing shell history, truncating logs, or stopping the audit daemon presumes there was activity worth hiding — a near-zero-false-positive post-compromise behavior on servers.
markers: history -c or .bash_history removal on a server
Audit daemon stopped or disabled outside a maintenance window
Log files cleared shortly after an interactive session
false_positives: Image-building or golden-image preparation pipelines that scrub history by design

behaviors.title: Fresh local account granted privileged group membership
behaviors.description: Creating a local account and shortly after adding it to sudo/wheel/admin is the classic durable-access chain: it survives credential rotation and password resets on compromised accounts.
markers: useradd followed by usermod/gpasswd into a privileged group within the same session
Account naming that mimics service accounts (svc-, backup-, ops-)
Creation performed by an account that itself logged in recently from a new source
false_positives: Legitimate provisioning runs — corroborate against change-management records

behaviors.title: ARP cache poisoning to establish an adversary-in-the-middle position
behaviors.description: A burst of gratuitous ARP rebindings from one station repositions traffic through the attacker. One rebind can be DHCP churn; a burst from a single source is positioning.
markers: IP-to-MAC binding changes for multiple hosts announced by one station
Duplicate-address warnings clustered in time on one segment
Cleartext credential or session capture opportunities on the affected segment
false_positives: DHCP lease churn after an outage

behaviors.title: Port and service discovery preceding exploitation
behaviors.description: Service discovery is cheap and noisy; its intelligence value is in what follows. A scan followed by targeted connections to the enumerated services from the same source escalates intent.
markers: Sequential or randomized connection probes across many ports from one source
Follow-on connections to a subset of the probed ports shortly after
false_positives: Authorized vulnerability-management or asset-inventory scanners — maintain a scanner allow-list
